name: Rosalyn Montgomery
source:
Rosylin (or 'Rose' if you want to get under her skin) is a sweet girl who spends her time studying the art of the dress. She's president of the fashion club and has connections to almost everyone at school, but she also might be the most generous person on campus. Never hesitating to give help or assistance to anyone who needs it, Rosylin is the girl to know if you need something done.

Rosylin took a liking to Tom on his first day. She does seem to tease him an awful lot, though. Is she toying with him, or does she see something that others overlook?
